text.p: Sharper Image Corp said Friday that lower October sales reflected the planned reduction in catalog advertising and the unavailability of certain products."
This was "due to manufacturers' delivery constraints, the company said, adding that it expects improvements in this area as it heads into the fourth quarter.
Sharper Image on Friday reported a two percent decrease in October sales, saying same store sales were down 10 percent.
It said that the planned reductions in its catalog advertising for October by almost 40 percent fewer pages and for the past several months had the expected impact of lowering sales.
The company said that the catalog pages mailed for The Sharper Image catalog in October were about 40 percent more productive as compared with last October.
